task.description:
Produce test specifications and test source stubs for all Stage 1 requirements (DB-01..DB-04, ES-01..ES-08).

Read the test developer guide in full before starting. Read the design artefacts and implemented source files to understand the exact interfaces you are testing.

## Required outputs

### 1. Test spec files (one per requirement group)
- `tests/specs/DB-01-04.md` — covering DB-01 (schema init), DB-02 (connection pool), DB-03 (transactional integrity), DB-04 (health check)
- `tests/specs/ES-01-08.md` — covering ES-01 (append), ES-02 (ordered read), ES-03 (idempotency), ES-04 (global stream), ES-05 (type registry), ES-06 (point-in-time), ES-07 (retention/archival), ES-08 (metadata)

Each spec MUST follow the format in the test developer guide and include:
- Test case ID (e.g. TC-DB-01-01)
- Requirement ID traced
- Preconditions
- Steps
- Expected result (verifiable, no vague language)
- Test type: unit or integration

### 2. Test source stubs
- `tests/unit/db_test.zig` — unit test file with one `test` block per test case in DB-01-04.md marked as skipped/TODO
- `tests/unit/event_store_test.zig` — unit test file with one `test` block per test case in ES-01-08.md marked as skipped/TODO
- `tests/integration/db_integration_test.zig` — integration test stubs for DB-03 (transaction rollback), DB-04 (health check)
- `tests/integration/event_store_integration_test.zig` — integration test stubs for ES-01 append round-trip, ES-03 idempotency deduplication, ES-04 global stream ordering

### 3. Update tests/integration/main_test.zig
Add comptime-import references to the new integration test files so `zig build test-integration` picks them up when a real DB is available.

## Constraints
- Do NOT implement test logic — stubs only (each test block calls `return error.SkipZigTest` or similar)
- Every test case ID in the spec must have a corresponding named `test` block in the source stub
- No `anyerror` — unit test stubs must compile clean
- Run `zig build test` after creating stubs to confirm they compile (skipped tests still compile)

## Acceptance criteria
- tests/specs/DB-01-04.md exists with at least 6 test cases covering all 4 DB requirements
- tests/specs/ES-01-08.md exists with at least 12 test cases covering all 8 ES requirements
- All 4 test source stubs exist and are referenced by the build
- `zig build test` exits 0 after stubs are added
- No vague language in expected results
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/DB-01-04.md exists with ≥6 test cases, all 4 DB req IDs traced
tests/specs/ES-01-08.md exists with ≥12 test cases, all 8 ES req IDs traced

result.summary: Produced test specs and test source stubs for all Stage 1 requirements (DB-01..DB-04, ES-01..ES-08). tests/specs/DB-01-04.md: 13 test cases covering all 4 DB requirements. tests/specs/ES-01-08.md: 22 test cases covering all 8 ES requirements. All 4 test source stubs created and wired into build. zig build test exits 0 with all stubs compiling cleanly (skipped).
